item.title: [Training Data] Simulating Humans at Scale: Simile's Joon Sung Park
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:35 I am somebody who is quite inspired by science fiction. And when you read science fiction that covers societies that have progressed far enough in its technological maturity, you always see two pillars. You have some version of AGI, and you have some version of simulations that really help guide the society. I do see an opportunity today to really take the first crack at building the simulation.
